params.caption: 🕹️ Miami Heat players get custom GTA 6 PS5 Pro packages The Miami Heat, the NBA team from the state that inspired GTA 6's setting, were gifted a unique set of PS5 Pro consoles this week. Player Myron Gardner shared a photo of his care package, which includes the PS5 Pro and two officially licensed GTA 6 DualSense controllers. A neat perk while the PS5 Pro is hard to find in stores. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 16:59 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @PlayStation · @RockstarGames 😍 React if you want one · 💬 Would you rather have this or the game? #GTA6 #PS5Pro #MiamiHeat #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
